title: Regional data sovereignty: analytics replication & tenant residency migration plan
creator: Priya Nambiar
description: Problem: Our existing analytics pipeline centralizes raw tenant events in a single region which prevents us from meeting customer requirements for data residency and creates a single blast radius for legal/regulatory requests. Goal: implement a flexible multi-region replication model plus a migration path so tenants can declare a residency region (or permitted set) and have their analytics data stored and queried in-region by default, while preserving console functionality (dashboards, per-tenant cost/latency breakdowns) and keeping costs predictable. Constraints: minimal disruption to existing customers, keep ingestion latency <500ms for hosted workloads, preserve existing observability and rollout tooling, and avoid duplicating compute for global aggregated metrics where possible.
acceptance_criteria: Tenant can set a residency tag in the Console and it is honored by the analytics pipeline
Raw event materialization for a resident tenant is stored in the tenant's region only (or explicit allow-list)
Console dashboards for resident tenants show full fidelity metrics without cross-region data fetches in the common path
Operators can run a controlled migration that reseeds per-tenant historical data to the new regional lake with progress tracking
Audit logs capture data movements and policy decisions for compliance reviews
Automated tests validate policy enforcement and fallbacks; no higher error rate in dashboards during rollout (<0.5% increase)
design_decisions: Per-tenant residency metadata will be the source of truth stored in the Console config DB (Postgres).
Ingest layer will be region-aware: ingest endpoints accept a tenant-residency header and write to regional Kafka topics (one topic per region + event type).

Two replication modes: (1) metadata-only centralization where only aggregated metrics stream to central pipelines; (2) full regional storage where raw events stay in-region and are materialized to a regional data lake (S3/GCS dual-bucket pattern).
Policy engine will be implemented as a compact service (residency-service) that exposes sync / async decisions; pipelines consult it for routing and for migration playbooks.

Cross-region aggregated metrics for enterprise/global dashboards will be computed from pre-aggregated export feeds to a central analytics cluster, avoiding full raw replication when allowed by tenant policy.

Migration uses a snapshot-and-tail approach: take a region-local snapshot of historical events, bulk copy to new region (if moving), then tail the live stream until cutover, with a reconciliation job verifying counts/checksums.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Feature flag residency metadata and expose in Console (backend + minimal UI).
Phase 1: Region-aware ingest and regional topic routing in non-production; end-to-end test with synthetic tenants.
Phase 2: Implement regional materialization jobs and residency-service; test migration workflow for a small synthetic tenant group.
Phase 3: Pilot with 3 low-risk customers who opt-in; monitor latency, cost, dashboard correctness and audit trails.
Phase 4: Open beta to self-serve residency in Console with migration tooling and operator rollback plan.
Phase 5: GA with docs, runbooks, and support training; deprecate legacy central-only pipeline for tenants that migrated.
migration_tasks: Build residency-service API and schema in Console DB (migrations, permissions).
Add residency header to ingest SDKs and gate regional topic routing in ingest gateways.
Create per-region materialization workers and S3/GCS bucket config management.
Develop snapshot/tail migration utility with progress checkpoints and checksum verification.
Add audit events for every cross-region movement and policy decision; wire into Console audit UI.
Create operator runbook: preflight checks, cutover steps, rollback path, and cost estimation tool.
qa_plan: Integration tests: simulate tenants with different residency settings; verify storage locations and aggregated metrics.
Load tests: validate ingest latency <500ms at expected QPS in each region and during migration tails.
Compliance tests: generate audit trails for sample migrations and ensure retention and masking policies are honored.
Chaos test: simulate region outage and verify automatic fallback to allowed alternate region or queued re-ingestion depending on tenant policy.
Manual verification: Console dashboard checks with internal analytics team for 3 pilot tenants.
